name: city-weather
description: Current conditions + 3-day forecast for any city via weather.payapi.market's x402 endpoints, routed through the SELAT Router. Paid per call (USDC on Base), no API key.

location.description: City or place name to fetch weather for (e.g. 'London', 'New York', 'Jakarta').

steps.label: current conditions — weather.payapi.market /current (routed x402 via SELAT Router)
3-day forecast — weather.payapi.market /forecast (routed x402 via SELAT Router)
